question: What physical positions and four-step dynamics are recoverable from the six final L0/L1 baselines under the already-frozen C001 probe protocol, executed on spare CPUs while RGB slot training continues?
hypothesis: Final A003-calibrated models permit valid CPU reference readouts; L0's lower latent loss need not imply either physical sufficiency or omission. The measurements may support or contradict the proposed supervised-reference advantage.

sources.consequence: Report accessible position information separately from prediction/planning. Preserve local4096/ridge1e-3 versus paper50000/ridge1e-6 differences and retain unexpected L0 success.

sources.consequence: Import unchanged functions; preserve exact C001 indices, controls, alpha and episode bootstrap. The only scientific execution adaptation is CPU inference/readout in place of GPU; no new control or target is added.

differences: Approved CPU checkpoint-analysis intent is applied to the already-planned final baseline probes, not neural-network training. C001's initial experiment harness uses GPU; this record explicitly declares CPU execution of the same probe computation. Models retain A003 float64/math inference and calibrated statistics. This is final test evaluation rather than A017's earlier validation-only temporal comparison. All outputs identify CPU execution; no test-driven model/planner or hyperparameter change is permitted.
contrary_evidence: A frozen linear readout may miss nonlinear information; sorted white positions are exchangeable positional ranks, not persistent identities. Reversing actions can preserve net displacement and be weak. Good readout is not good latent geometry or planning. Single-seed episode intervals omit training-seed uncertainty. CPU/GPU arithmetic can differ despite earlier sampled parity.

protocol.scope: Only the six existing final seed0 L0/L1 artifacts, under unchanged C001 physical-probe design. No neural optimizer updates, new calibration, test selection, new data, extra seeds or planner changes.
protocol.parents: Require actual passing A003 review bound to calibrated artifact and passing A016 review; verify step303000, n/kind/training seed0, float64/math/inference-only metadata. Check existing B001 test-controls review and exact test/train data bytes.
protocol.sampling: Identical C001 seeds [2026111511,n,split_is_test].4096 train episode draws; five windows per each1000 test episodes; starts uniform integers in[2,frames-4), preserving three history frames and four future steps. Save all episode/start indices. No validation selection or test fitting.
protocol.features: Use unchanged balls_probes.features batch32: current, factual four-step rollout, fixed reversal of four future actions preserving both past actions, and no_rollout. No true future observation enters the model. Features and model state must be finite.
protocol.readout: Reuse unchanged train-standardized float64 ridge alpha0.001, unpenalized intercept, fit current train positions only. Same frozen decoder scores current and future targets. Lexicographically sort white XY at fit/score; no prediction-dependent assignment.
protocol.statistics: Reuse unchanged per-coordinate Pearson, RMSE and2000 whole-episode bootstrap samples with seed2026111510. Preserve raw cases and decoder. Optional descriptive color summaries are mean coordinate Pearson and mean-ball Euclidean RMSE, derived without new fitting or inference.
protocol.validity: For first8 fixed test windows compare feature modes at batch32 against batch1 and reversed ordering with unchanged rtol1e-4/atol1e-5. Check all extracted features/decoder/predictions finite, ridge relative residual<=1e-8, unchanged state/checkpoint/data digests, CPU-only tensors and CUDA never initialized.
protocol.software_checks: Deterministic sampling exactly matches existing evaluate convention and remains in bounds; white sorting invariant; action reversal/history preserved via a recording fake CPU model; feature batch/permutation consistency; ridge matches independent augmented least squares and residual; nonfinite detection; CPU environment guard; source/data/parent binding checks.
protocol.execution: One CPU child at a time, eight threads, RSS<=16GiB, wall<=900seconds per model including15second cleanup reserve; reuse reviewed identity-checked owned-child stop behavior. Hide HIP/CUDA/ROCR devices. CPU work creates no GPU ledger row; record concurrent GPU ledger changes honestly. Each actual scientific and operational result needs literature review before the next case.
protocol.outputs: Canonical planned probes/RUN/{result,review,cases,probe} artifacts, additional sampled indices/features and C006 manifest. Result schema preserves C002 compatibility and adds seed/device/lineage/numerical checks. A failed/incomplete case remains explicitly incomplete and cannot supply a passing comparison cell.

success: The declared probe computation passes its own validity checks and produces reviewed descriptive physical measurements. No direction of scientific effect is required for validity; classify hypothesis failures as measured negatives rather than force a baseline ranking.
stop: Changed lineage/data/source, nonfinite values, grouping or residual failure, CUDA initialization, CPU memory/time exhaustion stop this CPU case and require review. Do not adjust data, precision, alpha, samples, thresholds or model weights from outcomes. The concurrent slot trainer remains untouched.
